import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*<-\s*(.*?)\s*$")
update = re.compile(r"\(\s*(\w+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)\s*")

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    match = assignment.match(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    if expression.isdigit():
        values[name] = int(expression)
    else:
        match = update.fullmatch(expression)
        if match:
            variable, increment, modulus = match.groups()
            values[name] = (values[variable] + int(increment)) % int(modulus)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "TMP")) + ";")
